ops.title: Keep batch intent immutable when a row-save attempt races
ops.description:
Owner: drive-lock coordinator (caller).
Next executable step: keep the original batch mine immutable across attempts; copy the merge result before rows_saved() applies drop_ended_texts, or calculate derived cleanup on an attempt-local copy.
Evidence: cfc47e545 committed() reuses mine across retries (:5037-5047). merged() returns mine itself when now==base (:5100-5101 in that commit). rows_saved() calls drop_ended_texts(mine,ended) before validation (:4738), which assigns undelivered=[] (:4366). On a first attempt where now equals the batch base, this mutates the original batch input. If another writer appends an undelivered message before the row check, that check races and the next merge compares original nonempty base, mutated empty mine, and concurrently appended now; merged() refuses at undelivered rather than preserving the old whole-save merge behavior. No batch command asked to edit undelivered.
Static review only; no tests run.

ops.text: A failed save attempt cannot mutate the original mine used by the next batch merge.
Finishing a job while a concurrent writer appends a message retains the old whole-save merge/refusal behavior.
